title: Wax Pack
description: A sealed 1980s wax pack of baseball cards with a slab of stale gum inside. Tear it open along your own path, flick the cards out across the table, and turn any card over to read its back.
intent: One tactile ritual finished to the edge: waxed paper that tears with a fibrous edge and keeps its creases, then cards with real weight that slide and settle.
